name: Motor protection reset permissive
summary: Allows the documented reset request when the protection and process conditions permit it.
description: Allows the documented reset request when the protection and process conditions permit it. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Reset request and fault status” at the input and “Reset permission” at the output. Reset is distinct from a new start command.
